today.desc_menstrual: Umzimba wakho uyakhipha. Ukuphumula, ukufudumala, nokunyakaza kancane kukusekela kahle manje.
today.desc_follicular: Amandla ayakhula. Isikhumba sakho sikhanya kakhulu, ingqondo yakho ibukhali. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlela nokudala.
today.desc_ovulation: Usezingeni eliphezulu. Ukuzethemba kuphezulu, isikhumba siyakhanya, nokuxhumana kufika ngokwemvelo.
today.desc_luteal: Ukuhamba kancane ukuhlakanipha. Umzimba wakho ulungiselela. Hlonipha lokho okudingekayo futhi uziphathe kahle.
today.desc_unknown: Rekhoda isikhathi sakho sokuqala ukuze uvule ulwazi lomjikelezo wakho.
today.cta_follicular: Leli sonto isikhumba sakho sikhanyile kakhulu. Isikhathi esihle sokubhuka ukususwa kwuboya noma itreatment yobuso.
today.cta_ovulation: Isikhumba sakho siyakhanya manje. Sebenzisa kahle ngetreatment.
today.countdown_days: Isikhathi sakho esilandelayo ngemizuzwana engu-{count} izinsuku
today.countdown_day: Isikhathi sakho esilandelayo ngemizuzwana engu-{count} usuku

log.title: tara-s
log.body: Ubehlale azi umzimba wakhe. Le ndawo ingeyakho ukukhumbula.

insights.title: Lokho umzimba wakho okushoyo.
insights.subtitle: Izikhombisi ezivela kulokho orekhodile.
insights.empty_title: Izinhlobo zakho zizovela lapha njengoba urekhoda.
insights.need_more_data_body: Rekhoda umjikelezo owodwa futhi TARA-S izoqala ukubona umjikelezo wakho.
insights.avg_duration: Isikhathi sakho sihlala isikhashana ezingu-{days} izinsuku.
insights.variability_consistent: Imijikelezo yakho ibe ngefanayo kakhulu muva nje.
insights.variability_regular: Imijikelezo yakho ilandelana kahle. Izinguquko ezincane kufanele ngokuphelele.
insights.variability_irregular: Imijikelezo yakho yokugcina ihlukile ngezinsuku ezingu-{days}. Ingcindezi, uhambo, noma ukugula kungabangela lokhu.

information.disclaimer_body: TARA-S yakhiwe phezu kocwaningo oluphelele, futhi sibambe lolo cwaningo ezingeni eliphezulu. Kodwa umzimba womuntu wesifazane ngamunye muhle ngendlela yakhe. Inhloso yethu ukuphela kwayo ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluhle kakhulu nokuhamba nawe ezigabeni zemvelo zomjikelezo wakho.

privacy.title: Lokho esikuphethe, nangesizathu.
privacy.subtitle: Lokhu kungokwakho. Konke.
privacy.section_collect_body: Izinsuku zakho. Izimpawu zakho. Akunye. Asidinga indawo yakho, oxhumana nabo, noma imikhuba yakho ngaphandle kwale app.
privacy.section_storage_body: Kulondekile emakhompyutheni e-EU. Akwabelwani. Akathengiswa. Kubani, nganoma yisiphi isizathu.
privacy.section_control_body: Thatha konke nawe, noma kulahle ngokuphelele. Ukuchofoza okukodwa ukuze ulande konke. Ukuchofoza okukodwa ukuze usule konke, phakade.
privacy.delete_confirm: Lokhu kuzosula konke ngokuphelele. Akukwazi ukubuyiselwa. Uqinisekile?

onboarding.welcome_body: Ngaphambi kokuba siqale, imibuzo embalwa ukuze sithole umjikelezo wakho.
onboarding.date_q1_sub: Lokhu kusisiza ukuthola ukuthi ukuphi emjikelezo wakho namuhla.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Izinsuku ezimbili zisisiza ukuthola umjikelezo wakho.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Izinsuku ezintathu futhi singaqala ukubona iphethini yakho.
onboarding.ready_sub: TARA-S izofunda kuhambisana nawe. Okurekhodayo okuningi, okuqondayo okuningi.

inactivity.title: Usekhona?
inactivity.body_before: Sithatha imfihlo yakho ngobuqotho. Uzophuma ngemizuzwana
